dt: Proposals due Feb 3, 2027 (ROSES-25 Amendment 81, element D.10); no NOI or Step-1 proposal
e: NASA's Astrophysics Theory Program funds basic theory that supports NASA's space astrophysics missions; ROSES-25 Amendment 81 released it as a new opportunity in November 2026. Proposals may include developing data analysis methods for astrophysics missions.
unv: Award sizes and number of awards for this call were not checked.
